hints.buildAndDownload: Triggers npm run build:widget on the server (may take ~1–2 min).

hints.ignoredUrls: URLs or paths the crawler should ignore completely (comma separated).
hints.sitemapUrl: If provided, the crawler will use this specific sitemap instead of guessing.
hints.rescrapeInterval: How often to automatically refresh knowledge from the website.
